# Awesome BC-250 [![Awesome](https://awesome.re/badge.svg)](https://awesome.re)

> A curated list of awesome resources for the **AMD BC-250** — the ex-crypto-mining board built around a cut-down PlayStation 5 APU that the community turned into a budget Linux gaming console, home lab, and local AI server.

The BC-250 is a surplus mining blade built around AMD's "Oberon" CPU + "Cyan Skillfish" GPU (`gfx1013`): 6× Zen 2 cores at ~3.5 GHz, 24 (of 40) RDNA 2 compute units, and 16 GB of shared GDDR6. It is **Linux-only** — there are no Windows GPU drivers — and requires a community-modded BIOS, a recent kernel with Mesa 25.1+, and active cooling. Done right, it games at RX 6600-class performance for a fraction of a Steam Machine's price. This list collects the guides, software, hardware, cooling, and component knowledge currently scattered across r/BC250Gaming, Discord, Telegram, and the wider web.

## Documentation & Wikis

- [AMD BC250 Documentation](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/) - The community "source of truth": specs, BIOS flashing, 7+ distro guides, troubleshooting, game database, and a catalogue of 145 case designs.
- [BC250 Unofficial Community Guide](https://github.com/katzzero/bc250-unofficial-community-guide) - From-zero-to-gaming walkthrough with per-topic guides (specs, BIOS, PSU, cooling, benchmarks, troubleshooting, AI) maintained from Discord data.
- [BC-250.info](https://bc250.info/) - Beginner-friendly wiki covering distro choice, BIOS, overclocking, and verified gaming performance.
- [SkillFishOS Documentation](http://www.skillfishos.com/en/docs/hardware-bc250/) - Hardware deep-dive (specs, flaws, measured compute/bandwidth) from the BC-250-specific distro.
- [mothenjoyer69/bc250-documentation](https://github.com/mothenjoyer69/bc250-documentation) - Original documentation repo focused on hardware and cooling notes.
- [vietsman/bc250-documentation](https://github.com/vietsman/bc250-documentation) - Companion docs to the patched Bazzite images.
- [MrrZed0/bc-250-bios](https://github.com/MrrZed0/bc-250-bios) - BIOS tools, stock dumps, and flashing utilities (`AfuEfix64.efi`).

## Getting Started

- [Quick Start](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/getting-started/quick-start/) - The 7-step checklist: flash BIOS, set VRAM, disable IOMMU, install Linux, install governor, game.
- [Prerequisites](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/getting-started/prerequisites/) - What to buy, what you need, and where to buy it.
- [From Zero to Gaming](https://github.com/katzzero/bc250-unofficial-community-guide/blob/main/00-from-zero-to-gaming.md) - Complete end-to-end build walkthrough from the community guide.
- [BC 250 Setup and Instructions](https://handheldmodz.com/bc-250-setup-and-instructions/) - Step-by-step Bazzite (GNOME) + Oberon governor install.
- [ASRock BC250 — Building the Budget Steam Machine](https://plug-world.com/posts/2026/asrock-bc250-the-budget-steam-machine/) - A complete practical build guide with cost breakdowns.
- [ASRock BC-250 How-To Guide: Every Use Case](https://synccomputers.co.uk/asrock-bc-250-how-to-guide-every-use-case/) - Budget gaming, emulation, cloud gaming, and AI use cases with community-verified setup steps.
- [Pocket Adventures BC-250](http://www.pocketadventures.com/bc250.asp) - Parts lists, case STLs, and links to build tutorials.
- [isaacalvex/AMD-BC-250-Project-Guide](https://github.com/isaacalvex/AMD-BC-250-Project-Guide) - "Stellar 250" — a Bazzite-based console build guide with full BOM and shopping links.

## Reviews & Articles

- [Benchmarking AMD's BC-250 — Steam Machine-like performance at half the price](https://www.tomshardware.com/pc-components/cpus/benchmarking-amds-bc-250-offering-steam-machine-like-performance-at-half-the-price-unlocking-40-cus-eight-zen-2-cores-on-the-repurposed-ps5-apu) - Tom's Hardware deep-dive on 40-CU unlock, 8-core unlock, and gaming performance.
- [BC-250 used for Steam Machine duty gains third-party hack to unlock all 40 CUs](https://www.tomshardware.com/video-games/pc-gaming/asrock-bc-250-used-for-steam-machine-duty-gains-third-party-hack-to-unlock-all-40-cus-mining-board-now-has-more-cus-than-a-base-ps5) - Early reporting on the 40-CU register patch.
- [RADV Vulkan Driver Support Being Worked On For The GPU Found In The Sony PS5 & BC-250](https://www.phoronix.com/news/AMD-RADV-PS5-BC-250) - Phoronix on the driver work that started it all.
- [Linux's AMD Radeon Vulkan Driver Adds Experimental Support For The BC-250](https://www.phoronix.com/news/Mesa-25.1-RADV-AMD-BC-250) - Mesa 25.1 experimental RADV support lands.
- [Bless The BC250, The Budget E-waste Steam Machine](https://aftermath.site/bc250-steam-machine-budget-computer/) - Aftermath's hands-on build and Cyberpunk benchmarks vs. the Steam Machine.
- [Mining Board Meets Bazzite: The $300 DIY Steam Machine](https://retrohandhelds.gg/mining-board-meets-bazzite-the-300-diy-steam-machine/) - A living-room console build overview with emulation setup (ES-DE, Decky Loader).
- [ASRock BC-250 40 CU Mod: Faster Steam Machine, Bigger Risk](https://cliffmar.tech/asrock-bc-250-steam-machine-40-cu-mod/) - A measured look at the silicon-lottery and thermal risk of the 40-CU unlock.
- [Repurposing Old AMD APUs For AI Work](https://hackaday.com/2026/03/18/repurposing-old-amd-apus-for-ai-work/) - Hackaday on running LLMs on the BC-250.
- [AMD BC-250 on Hacker News](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49140213) - Discussion of the budget Steam Machine build, incl. fan comparisons (Phanteks T30 vs P12) and core-unlock notes.
- [AMD BC-250 PassMark](https://www.cpubenchmark.net/cpu.php?cpu=AMD+BC-250&id=6495) - Aggregated CPU benchmarks (14,022 CPU Mark, 6c/12t) for comparing against other CPUs.

## BIOS & Firmware

- [Segfault / BC-250 BIOS (GitLab)](https://gitlab.com/TuxThePenguin0/bc250-bios) - The modded P3.00 with exposed chipset menu (`BC250_3.00_CHIPSETMENU.ROM`) — the community-standard BIOS.
- [BIOS Flashing Guide](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/bios/flashing/) - USB EFI-shell flashing, verified SHA256 hashes, and the critical CMOS clear.
- [BIOS Recovery Guide](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/bios/recovery/) - Recovering a bricked board with a hardware SPI programmer (CH347/Pico).
- [BC 250 BIOS Flash](https://handheldmodz.com/bc-250-bios-flash/) - Illustrated walkthrough of the EFI-shell flash method.
- [fanoush/bc250_memcfg](https://github.com/fanoush/bc250_memcfg) - Change VRAM/UMA allocation from Linux without a BIOS flash.
- [RescueMei/BC250-DXE-SMU-Core-Unlock](https://github.com/RescueMei/BC250-DXE-SMU-Core-Unlock) - BIOS DXE driver that enables the 2 disabled CPU cores on every boot.

## Operating Systems

- [Bazzite](https://bazzite.gg) - Fedora-Atomic gaming distro; the most "works out-of-the-box" option, Steam Deck UI available.
- [CachyOS](https://cachyos.org) - Arch-based with BORE scheduler and x86-64 v3/v4 packages; best raw gaming performance.
- [SkillFishOS](https://github.com/MTSistemi/SkillFishOS) - BC-250-specific Debian sid + KDE distro with live 40-CU control, overclocking, and Steam/EmuDeck preinstalled.
- [Distribution Guide](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/linux/distributions/) - Pros/cons of Fedora, Bazzite, CachyOS, Arch, Debian, Alpine, and SteamOS.
- [Bazzite Setup Guide](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/linux/bazzite/) - Full Bazzite install incl. governor and patched-kernel rebase.
- [vietsman/bazzite-deck-patched](https://github.com/vietsman/bazzite-deck-patched) - Pre-built Bazzite image with BC-250 kernel patches (GPU 2230/350 MHz caps + oberon-governor); GNOME/KDE variants live in sibling repos.
- [62fixolab/Latest-Bazzite-AMD-BC-250-Patched-Images](https://github.com/62fixolab/Latest-Bazzite-AMD-BC-250-Patched-Images) - Actively maintained Bazzite Deck/GNOME/KDE images with `cyan-skillfish-governor-smu`, telemetry fix, and experimental 40-CU builds.
- [pnbarbeito/bc250-arch](https://github.com/pnbarbeito/bc250-arch) - Arch install with `oberon-governor` and `mesa-git`.
- [Boundbygravity/bc250-arch-setup](https://github.com/Boundbygravity/bc250-arch-setup) - Post-install setup script for Arch.

## Performance & Tuning

- [filippor/cyan-skillfish-governor](https://github.com/filippor/cyan-skillfish-governor) - GPU frequency/voltage governor (dynamic scaling + overclocking); `-smu` and `-tt` variants.
- [bc250-collective/cyan-skillfish-governor](https://github.com/bc250-collective/cyan-skillfish-governor) - Rust governor with performance-profile auto-switching.
- [bc250-collective/bc250_smu_oc](https://github.com/bc250-collective/bc250_smu_oc) - CPU overclocking tools via SMU (3.5 → 3.85–4.0 GHz).
- [bc250-collective/bc250-acpi-fix](https://github.com/bc250-collective/bc250-acpi-fix) - ACPI table fix enabling CPU C/P-states (essential for proper idle).
- [bc250-collective/amd_smu_reverse_engineering](https://github.com/bc250-collective/amd_smu_reverse_engineering) - SMU firmware reverse-engineering notes and scripts.
- [cachenetics/project-ariel](https://github.com/cachenetics/project-ariel) - Firmware-liberation project with `arieltune`: GDDR6 timing tuning, APU/40-CU control, and a hardware manual.
- [Fred78290/nct6687d](https://github.com/Fred78290/nct6687d) - Fan/sensor driver needed for proper PWM control and temperature monitoring.

## Compute Unit & Core Unlock

- [duggasco/bc250-40cu-unlock](https://github.com/duggasco/bc250-40cu-unlock) - Kernel patch + build scripts that re-enable all 40 RDNA 2 CUs (24 default), with A/B benchmarks and harvest-map tooling.
- [WinnieLV/bc250-cu-live-manager](https://github.com/WinnieLV/bc250-cu-live-manager) - Userspace (UMR) CU/WGP unlock with a TUI dashboard and boot persistence — no kernel rebuild needed.
- [rw-r-r-0644/bc250-core-unlock](https://github.com/rw-r-r-0644/bc250-core-unlock) - SMU-message technique that enables the 2 disabled Zen 2 cores (6c/12t → 8c/16t).
- [GabriWar/bc250-core-cu-unlock](https://github.com/GabriWar/bc250-core-cu-unlock) - Linux SMU tool for 8 cores + 40 CUs without a BIOS flash; reverts on cold boot as a safety net.
- [Hexxeh/bc250-efi-core-unlock](https://github.com/Hexxeh/bc250-efi-core-unlock) - EFI shim that applies the core unlock at boot without touching the BIOS.
- [40 CU Unlock](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/system/40cu-unlock/) - Distro-specific install notes, thermal data, and selective CU masking guidance.

## Toolkits & Control Centers

- [redbeard1083/bc250-toolkit](https://github.com/redbeard1083/bc250-toolkit) - Menu-driven CachyOS toolkit: governors, swap/ZSWAP, on-the-fly overclock profiles, and CU unlock.
- [rpf16rj/bc250-steamos-real-toolkit](https://github.com/rpf16rj/bc250-steamos-real-toolkit) - All-in-one toolkit for real SteamOS: tuning profiles, CU unlock, fan control, and community fixes.
- [keyboardspecialist/bc250-steamos](https://github.com/keyboardspecialist/bc250-steamos) - SteamOS 3.8/3.9 toolkit: power/GPU tuning, CU unlock, RAM split, compressed swap, CEC, Decky plugin, and Plasma/Qt control UIs with atomic-update persistence.
- [samedayhurt/bc250-buddy](https://github.com/samedayhurt/bc250-buddy) - Modular Bazzite setup with matching revert scripts.
- [NeOdYmS/bazzite-bc250-toolkit](https://github.com/NeOdYmS/bazzite-bc250-toolkit) - Menu-driven Bazzite setup including the nct6683 → nct6687 sensor switch.
- [NexGen-3D-Printing/SteamMachine](https://github.com/NexGen-3D-Printing/SteamMachine) - 3D-printed Steam Machine case project with one-shot Bazzite tuning scripts.
- [movacx/bc250-control-center](https://github.com/movacx/bc250-control-center) - Graphical control center: monitoring, GPU/CPU tuning, fan PWM, and 40-CU dashboard.
- [gennro/bc250-toolkit](https://github.com/gennro/bc250-toolkit) - Scripts including a CachyOS CU-unlock script.

## Gaming

- [Game Compatibility Database](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/gaming/compatibility/) - Community-tested games with settings and FPS data.
- [Game Benchmarks](https://github.com/katzzero/bc250-unofficial-community-guide/blob/main/07-game-benchmarks.md) - 60+ community-tested games with FPS results across unlock configs.
- [bc250-collective/bc250-gaming-mode](https://github.com/bc250-collective/bc250-gaming-mode) - Steam Deck-style gamescope gaming session for desktop Linux.
- [ProtonDB](https://www.protondb.com) - Check game compatibility with Proton before installing.
- [Launch Options Reference](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/reference/quick-reference/) - `RADV_DEBUG=nohiz` and per-game environment tips.
- [Retro Handhelds Emulation Setup](https://retrohandhelds.gg/mining-board-meets-bazzite-the-300-diy-steam-machine/) - ES-DE, Decky Loader, and SteamGridDB living-room setup.

## AI & Machine Learning

- [akandr/bc250](https://github.com/akandr/bc250) - The definitive guide to Ollama + Vulkan LLM inference, image generation, and autonomous agents on the BC-250.
- [akandr/bc250-rocm](https://github.com/akandr/bc250-rocm) - Making ROCm/HIP compute work on GFX1013 with a patched kernel.
- [LLM Inference with RADV](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/drivers/radv/) - llama.cpp Vulkan setup and expected token rates.
- [Using a BC250 as an AI Inference Processor](https://jessestevens.com.au/2026/06/27/using-a-bc250-crypto-mining-board-as-an-ai-inference-processor-for-local-llms/) - Headless Ubuntu server + llama.cpp walkthrough.
- [Running Gemma 4 on a BC-250 with Ollama](https://www.tireddadtech.com/vault/running-gemma-4-on-amd-bc250-with-ollama) - MoE model sizing on the 16 GB unified pool.
- [Ollama](https://ollama.com) - LLM runtime with a Vulkan backend (the easiest inference path).
- [llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp) - The underlying inference engine, build with `GGML_VULKAN=ON`.

## Cooling

- [Cooling Guide](https://github.com/katzzero/bc250-unofficial-community-guide/blob/main/04-cooling-guide.md) - Heatsink mods, fans, thermal pads, and temperature targets.
- [Cooling Solutions](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/hardware/cooling/) - Static-pressure fan requirements and push-pull recommendations.
- [BC-250 Scooper](https://www.printables.com/model/1282906-bc-250-scooper) - 3D-printed tool for opening the sealed heatsink fin stack.
- [Arctic P12 Pro](https://www.arctic.de/en/P12-Pro/ACFAN00305A) - The community-recommended high static-pressure 120 mm fan (6.9 mmH₂O, 77 CFM, 600-3000 RPM).
- [BC-250 to AMD CPU Cooler Mount](https://www.printables.com/model/1042228-bc250-to-amd-cpu-cooler-mount) - Mounts AM4/AM5-style tower coolers onto the board (print in ABS, no supports).
- [BC-250 AM4/5 CPU Cooler Mount (MakerWorld)](https://makerworld.com/en/models/2596083-bc-250-am4-5-cpu-cooler-mount) - Alternative AM4/5 tower-cooler mount with profile presets.
- [onemorecap/bc-250-sleeve-adapter](https://github.com/onemorecap/bc-250-sleeve-adapter) - 3D-printed sleeve connecting the blade to a 120 mm fan for desktop use (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
- [BC-250 Arctic Liquid Freezer III 360 Mount](https://www.printables.com/model/1762821-bc250-aio-artic-liquid-freezer-iii-360-mount) - Mount for an Arctic Liquid Freezer III 360 mm AIO.
- [Old Lamer's Liquid-Cooled Steam Machine](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=afYhUQFa-AY) - Full 240 mm AIO liquid-cooling build with a NextGen3D case.

## Cases & Enclosures

- [NexGen3D DIY Steam Machine](https://www.printables.com/model/1499974-nexgen3d-diy-steam-machine-powered-by-bazzite) - The popular Steam-Machine-style case with single-fan static-pressure boosters and optional AIO mount.
- [BC-250 Quiet Case — Tower Cooler](https://www.printables.com/model/1652979-bc-250-quiet-case-tower-cooler) - Quiet case for a DeepCool AK400/AK500 tower cooler with optional display and front USB hub.
- [Community Cases Catalogue](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/community/cases/) - 145 searchable case/enclosure designs.
- [BC-250 to ATX Case Adapter](https://www.printables.com/model/1743485-bc250-to-atx-case-adapter) - Mounts the bare board into any ATX/mATX/ITX case with I/O shield; high-profile (RAM-cooling fan) and low-profile variants.
- [AMD BC-250 ITX Mount](https://makerworld.com/en/models/2533826-amd-bc-250-itx-mount) - Mount the board inside mini-ITX cases.
- [onemorecap/bc-250-shell-case](https://github.com/onemorecap/bc-250-shell-case) - Snap-on cooling shell housing a single 120 mm fan and a Mean Well LOP-300-12 PSU.
- [jardon/bc250-case](https://github.com/jardon/bc250-case) - Modular OpenSCAD case with airflow ducts, panels, and a PSU bracket.
- [Accurate 3D Model of the AMD BC-250 Board](https://www.printables.com/model/1341336-accurate-3d-model-of-the-amd-bc-250-board) - Reference board model for designing your own cases and mounts.
- [Case Mods & Custom Enclosures](https://github.com/katzzero/bc250-unofficial-community-guide/blob/main/13-case-mods.md) - 3D-printable and commercial case sources.
- [Legendary Makes BC-250 Case](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xblj-cXtgYU) - Dev-stage case with push/pull cooling, built-in PSU housing, and swappable skins.
- [Pocket Adventures Case](http://www.pocketadventures.com/bc250.asp) - Complete case with Flex ATX PSU support and dual 120 mm fans.

## Components & Accessories

- [Power Supply Guide](https://github.com/katzzero/bc250-unofficial-community-guide/blob/main/03-power-supply-guide.md) - Verified PSU options (FSP500-30AS Flex ATX, Mean Well LOP-400/600) with purchase links.
- [Prerequisites — Parts](https://elektricm.github.io/amd-bc250-docs/getting-started/prerequisites/) - Recommended fan, thermal pads, DP-to-HDMI adapter, and SSD picks.
- [WiFi & Peripherals](https://github.com/katzzero/bc250-unofficial-community-guide/blob/main/09-wifi-and-peripherals.md) - USB WiFi/BT adapters, SSDs, and USB accessories (the board has no wireless).
- [Display & Audio](https://github.com/katzzero/bc250-unofficial-community-guide/blob/main/08-display-and-audio.md) - DP-only output, passive DP→HDMI adapters, VRR, and multi-monitor notes.
- [WANGCL M.2 to 6-Port SATA Adapter](https://www.amazon.nl/dp/B0BVMC37SX) - ASM1166-based M.2 to 6× SATA 6 Gb/s converter; the board has no SATA ports, so this is the main way to add a drive array (PCIe 2.0 x2 caps combined throughput near 1 GB/s, flash newer firmware if drives drop out).
- [StarTech MR12GI M.2 2.5GbE NIC](https://www.startech.com/en-us/networking-io/mr12gi-network-card) - B+M-key 2280 Intel I225-V 2.5 GbE adapter that fits the M.2 slot and adds multi-gig networking alongside the board's single 1 GbE port.
- [Mabletech MTG-GM200 M.2 WiFi Adapter](https://mabletech.com/product/mtg-gm200/) - M.2 M-key to A+E-key adapter for 2230 WiFi/BT modules (e.g. Intel AX210); WiFi works over PCIe, Bluetooth needs an external USB connection (no internal USB header on the board).
- [JMT M.2 to PCIe x4 Riser](https://www.amazon.com/JMT-Adapter-Converter-Multiplier-Mining/dp/B09QYQTHY4) - Turns the M.2 slot into a full PCIe x4 slot for SATA HBA, 10 GbE, and capture cards (PCIe 2.0 x2 bandwidth still applies).
- [mosfet.party](https://mosfet.party/) - Custom PS_ON adapters (ATX 24-pin, FSP500-30AS), EPS-8pin to MicroFit converters, and backlit power buttons made for the BC-250.
- [mosfetparty/bc250-psu-adapter](https://github.com/mosfetparty/bc250-psu-adapter) - Open-source design files for the PS_ON adapter (FSP500-30AS plug-and-play, ATX 24-pin, and DIY mini versions).

## Communities

- [r/BC250Gaming](https://www.reddit.com/r/BC250Gaming/) - The main subreddit for builds, guides, and troubleshooting.
- [BC-250 Discord](https://discord.gg/8eZfFWhczz) - The largest community (6,000+ members) where new BIOS versions and tools are shared first.
- [BC-250 Telegram](https://t.me/BC250public) - Active group with BIOS files, flashing guidance, and quick help.
- [bc250-collective](https://github.com/bc250-collective) - GitHub org consolidating drivers, BIOS tools, and docs.

## Where to Buy

- [AliExpress](https://www.aliexpress.com/) - Search "BC-250" — board prices fluctuate heavily with YouTube coverage.
- [eBay](https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=bc-250) - Used boards, often with airflow mods or pre-flashed BIOS.
- [Pocket Adventures](http://www.pocketadventures.com/bc250.asp) - Pre-built BC-250 systems and parts.
